额窦疾病继发于未治疗的内侧爆裂性骨折

Frontal Sinus Diseases Followed by Untreated Medial Blow-Out Fractures.

中文摘要

爆裂性骨折（BOF）是一种由钝性创伤引起的常见眶壁骨折。对于有明显眼球内陷或复视的患者，通常建议手术修复，而小骨折常采用保守治疗。本文中，作者报告了2例在未治疗BOF患者中发生的额窦疾病。这些病例强调，不仅应将BOF视为眼科问题，还应将其视为鼻窦并发症的潜在原因。建议及时手术干预和密切的耳鼻喉科随访，以预防黏液囊肿或鼻窦炎等迟发后遗症。

英文摘要

Blow-out fracture (BOF) is a common orbital wall fracture caused by blunt trauma. Surgical repair is generally indicated in patients with significant enophthalmos or diplopia, whereas small fractures are often managed conservatively. Herein, the authors present 2 cases of frontal sinus disease arising in patients with untreated BOF. These cases highlight the importance of considering BOF not only as an ophthalmic concern but also as a potential cause of sinonasal complications. Timely surgical intervention and close otolaryngologic follow-up are recommended to prevent delayed sequelae such as mucocele or sinusitis.
